faq.title: FAQ and billing
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about plans, payments, renewal and messaging credits.

start.title: Getting started
start.startA: Create an account and tell us about your clinic. New accounts start on the Free plan while our team reviews them. You keep using the same account once it is approved.
start.freeQ: What does the Free plan include?
start.freeA: Free is for trying AltCare. It has limits on patients and doctors, and some features are only in paid plans. The current limits are always on the pricing page.

plans.title: Plans and prices
plans.listA: Four: Free, Plus, Pro and Enterprise. Free costs nothing. Plus and Pro have a fixed price. Enterprise is for hospitals, chains and institutions.
plans.pricesQ: How much do the plans cost?
plans.pricesLineYearly: {name} is {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year
plans.pricesFallback: Prices could not be loaded just now. Please see the pricing page for the current prices.
plans.savingQ: Is it cheaper to pay for a year?
plans.savingA: Yes. Paying for a year at once gives you {months} months free compared with paying monthly.
plans.enterpriseA: Enterprise is priced for each organisation. Talk to us and we will agree a price that fits your size.

paying.title: Paying
paying.howA: You pay online at checkout, in advance, for 1 month or 1 year. Your plan starts as soon as the payment is confirmed. You can use the payment methods shown at checkout.
paying.renewQ: Does my plan renew by itself?
paying.renewA: No. There is no automatic renewal and no surprise charges. You renew when you choose to.
paying.remindQ: Will you remind me before my plan ends?
paying.remindA: Yes. We email a reminder 7 days and 1 day before your plan ends.
paying.receiptA: After you pay, the receipt is available on the Billing page in your account.
paying.whoQ: Who can buy or renew a plan?
paying.whoA: Doctors in the clinic can buy or renew. Receptionists cannot.

ends.title: When a plan ends
ends.endQ: What happens when my plan ends?
ends.endA: Your clinic moves to the limits of the Free plan. Paid features and allowances stop until you renew.
ends.deleteA: No. Nothing is deleted when a plan ends. Your patients, prescriptions and records stay.
ends.renewQ: Can I renew or upgrade at any time?
ends.renewA: Yes. Renewing the same plan before it ends adds the new period after your current end date. If you upgrade to a higher plan, the new plan starts at once, and the unused time on your old plan is not credited.
ends.lowerQ: Can I move to a lower plan?
ends.lowerA: Yes, after your current period ends.
ends.clinicQ: Who holds the plan, the clinic or the doctor?
ends.clinicA: The clinic. The plan, the messaging credits and the receipts belong to the clinic, not to one doctor.

credits.title: Messaging credits
credits.allowanceQ: What is the monthly SMS and email allowance?
credits.allowanceA: Each plan includes a number of SMS and emails every month. The allowance does not roll over to the next month.
credits.packsQ: What if I use it all up?
credits.packsA: You can buy a credit pack for SMS or email. Purchased credits are used after your monthly allowance.
credits.providerQ: Do I need my own SMS or email service?
credits.providerA: No. AltCare sends SMS and email for you. You never set up a provider.

facebook.title: Facebook promotion
facebook.whatA: On the Pro and Enterprise plans, AltCare can feature your public profile on the AltCare Facebook page.
facebook.howManyQ: How many times can I be featured?
facebook.howManyA: Pro includes one feature each quarter. Enterprise includes three each quarter.
facebook.approveA: Our staff write the post. You see the exact text first and approve it. Nothing is posted without your approval.

safety.title: Privacy and safety
safety.privacyA: Read how we handle information in our Privacy Policy.
safety.medA: No. AltCare is a tool for record keeping, not a substitute for professional judgement. Read the medical disclaimer.
safety.reportQ: How do I report a problem with a profile?
safety.reportA: Send us a message through the contact page and tell us which profile and what is wrong.

faq.helpBody: Ask us about billing, or read the refund and cancellation policy.

refund.title: Refund and cancellation policy
refund.intro: This page explains how to cancel and when a payment to AltCare can be refunded.
refund.s1Body: Plans do not renew automatically. To cancel, simply do not renew. Nothing is charged after your plan ends.
refund.s2Body: If you were charged but the plan or the credits were not added to your clinic, contact us with your receipt number. We will fix it or refund you.
refund.s3Body: If you were charged twice, or charged the wrong amount, we will refund the difference.
refund.s4Body: Otherwise, a payment for a plan period or a credit pack is not refunded once the plan is active or the credits have been added.
refund.s5Body: Refunds go back to the payment method that was used. How long it takes depends on the payment provider.
refund.s6Body: Send us a message with the receipt number from your Billing page.
